config.addRoot: Folder that **Add folder…** looks in. When empty, the folder the workspace file is in.
config.browser: macOS app name that **Open in Browser** uses. When empty, the file opens in its default app (PDF → Preview). Other systems always use the default app.
config.claudeCodeCss: CSS rules added to Claude Code's panel, one rule per item. `{{pill+pillOn}}` stands for the `pill` class of the Claude Code module that also has `pillOn`, so a rule keeps working when an update changes the class names. Reload the window to see a change.
config.shortcuts: A list of commands pinned in the **Shortcuts** tab. Each has a `label` and a `command` (and optional `args`). Add them from the tab itself or edit here.
config.sessionLocation: Where a session picked in the **Claude Sessions** tab opens: `sidebar` replaces the session in Claude Code's side panel, `editor` opens an editor tab.
